jobs.description:
BYD Automotive GmbH is a subsidiary of BYD in Germany, which is an important part of BYD's international business in response to German customers and radiating the European market. As an essential part of the new energy field, BYD's battery business opening up all links in the entire industrial chain of energy from harvesting to storage, to application. About BYD Automotive GmbH:
Company Website: https://www.byd.com/de

Battery Maintenance Technician (m/f/d)
Workplace: Hoppegarten, Germany
Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Responsibilities:

1. Adherence to Defined Procedures

- Strictly execute all repair, testing, and self-inspection tasks in strict compliance with the official Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Conduct a self-inspection at the end of each task or batch to verify quality before movement.

2. Task Management & Communication

- Complete all assigned daily tasks within the specified timeframe.
- Proactively and promptly report work status updates, completion confirmations, and any abnormalities or issues encountered during shift.

3. Equipment & Worksite Maintenance

- Perform daily maintenance of all tools, testing equipment, and the workstation according to the prescribed maintenance schedule and checklist.
- Maintain a clean, organized, and safe (5S) work environment.

4. Quality Assurance

- Maintain the highest quality standard for all reworked units.
- Ensure a 100% quality check to prevent any Non-Conforming (NG) parts from advancing to the next production or assembly step.

5. Continuous Improvement

- Actively collaborate with Process Engineers to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Provide feedback and assist in optimizing battery testing and repair procedures to enhance efficiency, quality, and safety.

Job Requirements:

1. Good communication and teamwork skills, strong sense of responsibility.
2. E-auto battery working background and be good at practical things.
3. Driver license, license of forklift, certificate of Hochvolt FHV stufe 2s , electrician knowledge are preferred.
4. English proficiency is required; German or Chinese is a plus.
5. Acceptable for high business travel frequency (approx. 30%).

We sincerely welcome you who have the same vision to join BYD to create the prospects of the industry and build a green home together.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work (https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/) list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 

Join a group of talent acquisition experts who are the top of their field for attracting and hiring the top of every other field. We manage the full candidate lifecycle and just as Bain is only as good as its people, its people are only as good as our process. If you’re interested in learning how a top management consulting firm creates an impressive candidate experience, this is the team for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- As Associate, Recruiting (m/f/d), you will support our Intern Hire Team in attracting outstanding talent for consulting internships across our offices in Germany & Austria.
- In this role, you will serve as the central point of contact for all candidates throughout the Talent Journey – from the initial contact at a university event through to candidate support during our assessment days.
- You will also be responsible for the pre-selection of the most promising candidates for our selection process and will oversee the preparation, execution and follow-up of our assessment days.
- You give free rein to your creativity in conceptualizing, planning and executing our campus activities and (flagship) recruiting events, and collaborate with your team colleagues to develop strategies and concepts to further advance our intern hiring.
- With your communicative and approachable manner, you also support our internal consultants with all recruiting-related queries.
- To make our recruiting success measurable, you regularly prepare analyses along the Talent Journey and present these to your key stakeholders.

ABOUT YOU

- You have a genuine passion for talent and recruiting.
- You leverage your strong communication skills to attract talented individuals to Bain.
- You have a strong service orientation and a genuine enthusiasm for daily interaction with candidates and Bainies.
- You look forward to taking on responsibility and independently driving topics forward. 
- You are a resilient and assertive organisational talent who does not shy away from challenges and keeps a cool head under pressure.
- You truly thrive in a team setting, built on a foundation of loyalty and reliability.
- You are creative, have a sense of humor and impress with a warm and positive presence.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

- You hold a successfully completed university degree in business administration, social sciences or law, ideally with a focus on human resources management.
- You bring initial experience in recruiting and/or campus marketing. 
- You are proficient in MS Office; initial knowledge of data analytics is an advantage.
- Your German and English language skills are excellent, both spoken and written

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In addition to an attractive and performance-based remuneration comprising fixed and variable components, you will benefit from numerous additional perks:

- Diverse training formats, language courses as well as buddy and mentoring programmes support your personal development
- You benefit from the EGYM Wellpass and further offerings for fitness and mental wellbeing
- Our mobility concept gives you the flexibility to choose between Mobility Cash, reimbursement of your public transport ticket or JobRad leasing
- For us, flexibility means having the best of both worlds: the freedom to work from home and the opportunity to experience genuine team moments in the office – fully in line with our Work@Bain 2.x concept.
- With our Community Impact Day and participation in Green Teams, you can make a meaningful difference for society and the environment
- Affinity Groups such as Women@Bain promote exchange, networking and career development
- Whether Team Retreat, Christmas Party or the „Bain-Wiesn“ – you will experience how fun and team spirit go hand in hand at Bain.
- Whether free snacks, beverages or the subsidised catering in our cafeteria (in Munich) – you will find even more at Bain that makes your working day a little bit better.

HOW YOU´LL JOIN US

Have we sparked your curiosity about an exceptional career with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV, cover letter, certificates, references) via our application portal.

jobs.occupation: Admissions & Programme Manager of Venture Support Programmes (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities Your Input You understand the challenges of healthcare venture building and are passionate about supporting early-stage entrepreneurs, innovators and researchers through education, mentoring, and capacity-building programmes. As Admissions & Programme Manager, you will manage participant admissions, support learners throughout the programme lifecycle, and help deliver an outstanding learning experience. In collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will also contribute to the design, implementation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of our venture support programmes.
Responsibilities
• Manage the admissions process, assess applicants, and guide entrepreneurs and researchers to the most suitable venture support programmes and opportunities, such as venture-building programmes, bootcamps, Catapult initiatives, and scholarship opportunities.
• Lead programme implementation, including call launches, applicant engagement, stakeholder coordination, and project management throughout the programme development cycle.
• Support programme growth and operations by coordinating launches, optimizing existing programmes, managing invoices, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with Horizon Europe funding requirements.
• You will also support the exploitation of the existing content in future implementations - based on lessons learned, market and clients' needs.
• Collaborate across the portfolio to ensure a smooth progression of participants between programmes, connecting innovators and entrepreneurs with the most relevant next-step opportunities, such as advanced venture support programmes and bootcamps.
• Coordinate pitching days and showcase events together with programme managers and the events team.

Your skills & knowledge What you bring
• Master’s degree or higher in health, science, business or entrepreneurship education studies or equivalent professional experience/qualifications.
• High level international project management skills, with a good understanding of the complexities involved in developing and delivering project outcomes; proven ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.
• Good understanding of the start-up journey in healthcare; ability to identify their opportunities for improvement and growth; experience in setting and managing standards of delivery to support the cost-effective and targeted delivery of activities and/or programmes.
• Sound knowledge of higher education programmes in Europe.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.
• Solution-oriented team player and comfortable working primarily remotely.
• Ability to work with an international team in a multidisciplinary context and to multi-task and manage a set of deliverables simultaneously.
• Languages: English fluent (spoken, written), other European languages an advantage.
• Experience in grant management, particularly European Grants (Erasmus+, Horizon 2020, EIT, Horizon Europe …) is a plus.
• Prior experience in entrepreneurship education and training is a plus.
• Occasional travel (2–4 times per year) may be required.

What we offer
• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, France, Spain and Poland.
• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.
• 30 days of vacation & flexible working hours.
• Yearly bonus and our employee recognition programme.
• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.
• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior rep-resentatives from key players and influencers.
• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.

Application process
• EIT Health applies a policy of equal opportunities and accepts applications without discrimination on any grounds.
• Applications should consist of a cover letter and a full curriculum vitae.
• Please include the following in the cover letter: introduction, your motivations for applying for the position, your earliest start date, and your salary expectations.
• Applications via our careers page only.
• Applications will be reviewed on the rolling basis until the right candidate is identified. The position is to be filled as soon as possible.

About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.
Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.
As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. By combining their collective expertise we help new solutions reach the people and services that need them most.
For more information please visit our website: www.eithealth.eu

kiutraDo you want to shape the future as part of a diverse, international team in a fast-growing, deep-tech company? Then read on! At kiutra, we contribute to the development and application of quantum technologies by offering innovative and sustainable cooling solutions based on our unique magnetic cooling technology.

To strengthen our team, we're looking for a Chief of Staff (f/m/d) who's ready to work closely with our Managing Director. You dig into topics, get the right people talking, and and stay on top of open items. In this role you bring solid know-how in corporate law, compliance, financing, and accounting to the materials, proposals, and advisor conversations you help shape. You run with things independently and need little guidance.
Responsibilities
• You prepare decisions for the Managing Director, working through the facts, laying out options, and producing materials and resolution proposals.
• You support processes owned by functional departments or external advisors, preparing the Managing Director's input, consolidating information, and organizing alignment.
• You coordinate participants, deadlines, and work status across departments, advisors, and countries.
• You follow up on open items and deadlines, flagging early when topics stall or drift apart.
• You take care of documentation and record keeping minutes, resolutions, deadline overviews, and tracking of commitments made.
• You independently handle clearly defined work packages on behalf of the Managing Director, working with a high degree of autonomy.

Requirements
• You hold a completed university degree in law, business, natural sciences, or comparable; a legal background is an advantage given the governance topics involved.
• You bring 3 to 6 years in management consulting, investment banking, a commercial law firm, audit, or a comparable role in a growing technology company.
• You have hands-on experience handling commercial, corporate law, or regulatory matters.
• You solve problems in a structured and analytical way.
• You coordinate and keep track across several topics, including reliable follow-up on open items until completion.
• You're confident with numbers: budget, forecast, fundamentals of financial accounting, and you're willing to get to grips with corporate law and tax questions.
• You have full professional proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken).
• You prepare complex matters precisely and concisely for the respective audience.
• You handle confidential shareholder, compensation, and transaction information with the utmost discretion and integrity.
• You stay calm and adaptable when priorities shift or things are unclear.
• You're ready to align your pace with the Managing Director's including occasional travel as needed.
• You're interested in deep tech and hardware; prior technical knowledge is not required.

Benefits
• You will enjoy flexibility with options for remote work and flexible working hours.
• You will experience an open-minded, appreciative startup atmosphere with flat hierarchies and an open-door policy.
• You will work with a great team in a fast-growing deep-tech company.
• You can expect regular performance reviews and long-term job prospects.
• You can look forward to 30 vacation days per year.
• You will have the chance to participate in valuable employee surveys.
• You will work in a comfortable, bright and modern office with ergonomic equipment in compliance with health requirements.
• You can benefit from “The Coolest Connection”, our employee referral program.
• You will have the opportunity to get to know your team members better at our teambuilding events, Christmas parties, and other group events.
• You will have free cold and hot drinks, snacks, and fruit at your disposal.
• You can benefit from our company's pension plan, our bicycle leasing program (Jobrad), and contribution for the Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket.

Interested? Then send us your application now! To find out more about us, please visit https://kiutra.com/

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. * Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board
